layout.body:
Elena Rowe (4:44 p.m.)
Hey Eli. I'm having a problem with my mini fridge. I hear the motor humming, but it's not cooling off. David from our history class tells me you're good at fixing things like this. Could you come by and have a look?
Eli Molina (4:45 p.m.)
Hey Elena. I'd be happy to take a look. Right now I'm in the library with my math study group. We just got here.
Elena Rowe (4:46 p.m.)
Oh, I didn't mean right away. Any time is good.
Eli Molina (4:47 p.m.)
How about tomorrow at 12:30?
Elena Rowe (4:48 p.m.)
My economics class starts at noon. Does 1:30 work?
Eli Molina (4:50 p.m.)
That works fine. Chances are it's a broken condenser coil. I've got an extra one, so I'll bring it with me.
Elena Rowe (4:51 p.m.)
Thank you so much!

questions.stem: What can be concluded about Eli?

options.A: He works at an appliance repair shop.
options.B: He has repaired refrigerators in the past.
options.C: He is studying to be a mechanical engineer.
options.D: He meets with his math study group every week.

questions.analysis: What can be concluded about Eli? 原文依据：David from our history class tells me you're good at fixing things like this. / Chances are it's a broken condenser coil. I've got an extra one. 翻译：同班同学说伊莱擅长修理这类物品，他能准确判断冰箱故障，还自备备用零件。 选项分析： (A) He works at an appliance repair shop. 在电器维修店工作 → 错误，原文无职业相关信息，仅为个人动手能力强 (B) He has repaired refrigerators in the past. 以前修理过冰箱 → 正确，懂故障原因、有备用零件，说明有维修经验 (C) He is studying to be a mechanical engineer. 主修机械工程 → 错误，只提到数学学习小组，无专业信息 (D) He meets with his math study group every week. 每周固定小组学习 → 错误，仅说明当下正在小组学习，无法推断每周惯例

questions.stem: At 4:48 P.M., what does Elena imply when she writes, “My economics class starts at noon”?

options.A: She has to arrive early to her economics class.
options.B: Eli can work on the problem while she is in class.
options.C: She cannot meet Eli at the time he has suggested.
options.D: Her economics professor has changed the class start time.

questions.analysis: What does Elena imply when she writes, “My economics class starts at noon”? 原文依据：How about tomorrow at 12:30? My economics class starts at noon. Does 1:30 work? 翻译：伊莱提议 12:30 见面，埃琳娜表示中午有课，另行提议 1:30 会面时间。 选项分析： (A) She has to arrive early to her economics class. 需要提前去上课 → 错误，原文无提前到校的表述 (B) Eli can work on the problem while she is in class. 上课期间维修 → 错误，二人在协商避开上课的见面时间 (C) She cannot meet Eli at the time he has suggested. 无法赴约对方提出的时间 → 正确，因课程冲突拒绝 12:30 (D) Her economics professor has changed the class start time. 上课时间临时调整 → 错误，文中无时间变动内容

questions.stem: What does Eli suggest about Elena's refrigerator?

options.D: It must be brought to a shop.

questions.analysis: What does Eli suggest about Elena's refrigerator? 原文依据：Chances are it's a broken condenser coil. I've got an extra one, so I'll bring it with me. 翻译：冰箱大概率是冷凝器线圈损坏，他会携带备用零件上门更换。 选项分析： (A) It needs a new part. 需要更换新零件 → 正确，线圈损坏、自带备件，对应更换零件 (B) It cannot be repaired. 无法维修 → 错误，伊莱主动上门修理，可修复 (C) It is a low-quality model. 冰箱质量差 → 错误，全文无评价冰箱品质的内容 (D) It must be brought to a shop. 需要送店维修 → 错误，约定上门修理，无需外送
